headline: Keep {arm:September}: both challengers cost more per reply while regressing on character adherence.
lede: {arm:September} delivers the highest adherence pass rate at {pass_rate.September|pct} for {cost_per_1k.September|usd} per 1,000 replies. Neither candidate beats the baseline on persona fidelity or cost.

slots.text: Retain {arm:September} in production. It achieves {pass_rate.September|pct} adherence while serving traffic at {cost_per_1k.September|usd} per 1,000 replies.

{arm:1017} increases costs by {cost.uplift.1017|pct} and regresses on holds_character by {contrast.1017.persona.holds_character.delta|abs|pts} points ({contrast.1017.persona.holds_character.interval|pts}); {arm:qwen3.8-flash} drops adherence pass rate by {reading.qwen3.8-flash.change|abs|pts} points ({reading.qwen3.8-flash.interval|pts}) at higher cost.

Earlier insights noted {arm:qwen3.8-flash} lowers production costs, but production-replicating spend increased. Reasoning ratio varied from {reasoning_ratio.September|pct} down to {reasoning_ratio.1017|pct}, confounding model comparisons. Two degraded runs excluded one cell each.
Re-test candidate checkpoints only if prompt directives explicitly mitigate the off_lane character drop observed across all models.

caveats.material_if: The asked aspect was declared late, material only if evaluated dimensions did not reflect operational objectives.
The control baseline was designated late, material only if another variant served as the historical production baseline.
The judge has insufficient calibration, material only if relative cross-arm rankings invert under human review.

method.text: {cases} cases evaluated with {repeats} repeats per case, yielding {scoreboard.September.ran} trials per arm.
A trial passes character adherence when automated checks succeed and the judge passes persona fidelity.
Contrasts evaluate {family.family_size} comparisons with Holm adjustment at alpha {family.alpha}, interval level {family.level}.
{judge.model} evaluated transcripts under tier {judge.tier} with calibration {judge.calibration}.
Simulator request settings were not recorded across runs and may have varied between arms.
Token counts and raw llm_calls telemetry were excluded from report bundles.

explore.recomputes: No margin threshold flips the decision to a candidate because {arm:September} dominates on both cost and quality. {arm:1017} drops out of margin if margin is set below {flip_margin.1017|pts} points; {arm:qwen3.8-flash} drops out below {flip_margin.qwen3.8-flash|pts} points.
